metadata.subject: Maths
metadata.author: Antigravity Supreme Intelligence
learning_outcomes: Understand the geometrical meaning of the zeroes of a polynomial.
Find the zeroes of a quadratic polynomial.
Verify the relationship between zeroes and coefficients.
Solve CBSE/State Board HOTS questions related to Polynomials.

ai_context.learning_goal: Make algebraic expressions visual. Use the 'Socratic Discovery Arc' to connect algebraic equations with graphs before jumping to formulas.
common_misconceptions: Students confuse the degree of a polynomial with the number of terms.
Students struggle with the relationship between zeros and coefficients.

blocks.content: Imagine you throw a ball in the air. The path it takes forms a beautiful curve called a parabola. Did you know you can predict exactly where the ball will land using just one equation? Welcome to the magic of **Polynomials (बहुपद / બહુપદીઓ)**!
A Polynomial Rollercoaster: The graph of a quadratic polynomial creates a curve that crosses the x-axis. The points where it crosses are the 'Zeroes'!
blocks.alt_text: A glowing parabolic curve crossing the x-axis at two points, representing the zeroes of a polynomial.

blocks.content:
**Degree of a Polynomial (बहुपद की घात / બહુપદીની ઘાત):**
The highest power of x in p(x) is called the degree of the polynomial.

* Linear Polynomial (रैखिक बहुपद): Degree 1, e.g., 2x - 3
* Quadratic Polynomial (द्विघात बहुपद): Degree 2, e.g., ax² + bx + c
* Cubic Polynomial (त्रिघात बहुपद): Degree 3, e.g., ax³ + bx² + cx + d
💡 **Teacher's Secret:** The degree tells you the MAXIMUM number of zeroes a polynomial can have. A quadratic polynomial (degree 2) like ax² + bx + c can have at most 2 zeroes!
Visualizing Zeroes: Just look at the x-axis. The number of times the graph intersects the x-axis is exactly the number of zeroes (शून्यक / શૂન્યો) the polynomial has.
blocks.alt_text: Different graphs intersecting the x-axis, illustrating 1, 2, and 3 zeroes.

blocks.content:
🔥 **BOARD EXAM HOT TOPIC:** Relationship between Zeroes and Coefficients

For a quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c, if α and β are the zeroes:
**Sum of zeroes (α + β) = -b/a**
**Product of zeroes (α × β) = c/a**

*Board Trick:* Often, questions will give you the sum and product and ask for the polynomial. Just use: x² - (α + β)x + αβ!

**The Zero Rule:**
Finding a zero means setting p(x) = 0. Geometrically, this is where the height (y-value) is zero—which is exactly on the x-axis! So, if the graph doesn't touch the x-axis, there are no real zeroes.

blocks.question: The zeroes of the quadratic polynomial x² + 7x + 10 are:
blocks.question_hi: द्विघात बहुपद x² + 7x + 10 के शून्यक हैं:
blocks.explanation: x² + 7x + 10 = x² + 5x + 2x + 10 = x(x+5) + 2(x+5) = (x+2)(x+5). Thus, zeroes are -2 and -5.

blocks.question: A quadratic polynomial whose zeroes are -3 and 4 is:
blocks.question_hi: एक द्विघात बहुपद जिसके शून्यक -3 और 4 हैं, वह है:
blocks.explanation: Sum of zeroes = -3 + 4 = 1. Product = -3 × 4 = -12. Polynomial is k(x² - (sum)x + product) = k(x² - x - 12). For k=1, it is x² - x - 12.
blocks.explanation_hi: शून्यकों का योग = -3 + 4 = 1. गुणनफल = -3 × 4 = -12. बहुपद है k(x² - (योग)x + गुणनफल) = k(x² - x - 12)। k=1 के लिए, यह x² - x - 12 है।

blocks.question: If one zero of the quadratic polynomial x² + 3x + k is 2, then the value of k is:
blocks.question_hi: यदि द्विघात बहुपद x² + 3x + k का एक शून्यक 2 है, तो k का मान है:
blocks.explanation: Substitute x = 2 in the polynomial and equate to 0: (2)² + 3(2) + k = 0 => 4 + 6 + k = 0 => k = -10.

blocks.question: The number of polynomials having zeroes as -2 and 5 is:
blocks.question_hi: -2 और 5 शून्यक वाले बहुपदों की संख्या है:
blocks.explanation: There are infinitely many polynomials with given zeroes, in the form k(x - a)(x - b) where k is any non-zero real number.
blocks.explanation_hi: दिए गए शून्यकों वाले अनंत बहुपद होते हैं, k(x - a)(x - b) के रूप में जहाँ k कोई शून्येतर वास्तविक संख्या है।

blocks.question: If the zeroes of the quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c (c ≠ 0) are equal, then:
blocks.question_hi: यदि द्विघात बहुपद ax² + bx + c (c ≠ 0) के शून्यक समान हैं, तो:
options: c and a have opposite signs
c and b have opposite signs
c and a have the same sign
c and b have the same sign
options_hi: c और a के चिन्ह विपरीत हैं
c और b के चिन्ह विपरीत हैं
c और a के चिन्ह समान हैं
c और b के चिन्ह समान हैं
blocks.explanation: For equal zeroes, discriminant D = 0 => b² - 4ac = 0 => b² = 4ac. Since b² is always positive, ac must be positive, which means a and c have the same sign.
blocks.explanation_hi: समान शून्यकों के लिए, विविक्तकर D = 0 => b² - 4ac = 0 => b² = 4ac। चूँकि b² हमेशा धनात्मक होता है, ac धनात्मक होना चाहिए, जिसका अर्थ है a और c के चिन्ह समान हैं।

blocks.question: The zeroes of the quadratic polynomial x² + 99x + 127 are:
blocks.question_hi: द्विघात बहुपद x² + 99x + 127 के शून्यक हैं:
blocks.explanation: Sum of zeroes is -99 and product is 127. If product is positive, both zeroes have the same sign. Since sum is negative, both zeroes must be negative.
blocks.explanation_hi: शून्यकों का योग -99 और गुणनफल 127 है। यदि गुणनफल धनात्मक है, तो दोनों शून्यकों के चिन्ह समान होते हैं। चूँकि योग ऋणात्मक है, दोनों शून्यक ऋणात्मक होने चाहिए।

blocks.question: If one of the zeroes of a quadratic polynomial of the form x² + ax + b is the negative of the other, then it:
blocks.question_hi: यदि x² + ax + b रूप के एक द्विघात बहुपद का एक शून्यक दूसरे का ऋणात्मक है, तो यह:
options: has no linear term and the constant term is negative
has no linear term and the constant term is positive
can have a linear term but the constant term is negative
can have a linear term but the constant term is positive
options_hi: रैखिक पद नहीं होता है और अचर पद ऋणात्मक होता है
रैखिक पद नहीं होता है और अचर पद धनात्मक होता है
रैखिक पद हो सकता है लेकिन अचर पद ऋणात्मक होता है
रैखिक पद हो सकता है लेकिन अचर पद धनात्मक होता है
blocks.explanation: Let zeroes be α and -α. Sum = 0 => -a = 0 => a = 0 (no linear term). Product = -α² = b. Since α² > 0, -α² is negative, so b is negative.
blocks.explanation_hi: माना शून्यक α और -α हैं। योग = 0 => -a = 0 => a = 0 (रैखिक पद नहीं)। गुणनफल = -α² = b। चूँकि α² > 0, -α² ऋणात्मक है, इसलिए b ऋणात्मक है।

blocks.question: If α and β are the zeroes of the polynomial f(x) = x² - p(x + 1) - c, then (α + 1)(β + 1) is equal to:
blocks.question_hi: यदि α और β बहुपद f(x) = x² - p(x + 1) - c के शून्यक हैं, तो (α + 1)(β + 1) किसके बराबर है:
blocks.explanation: f(x) = x² - px - (p+c). α+β = p, αβ = -(p+c). Then (α+1)(β+1) = αβ + α + β + 1 = -(p+c) + p + 1 = 1 - c.

blocks.question: If the zeroes of the quadratic polynomial x² + (a+1)x + b are 2 and -3, then:
blocks.question_hi: यदि द्विघात बहुपद x² + (a+1)x + b के शून्यक 2 और -3 हैं, तो:
blocks.explanation: Sum of zeroes = 2 + (-3) = -1. But sum = -(a+1) => -(a+1) = -1 => a = 0. Product = 2(-3) = -6. Product = b => b = -6.

blocks.question: A polynomial of degree n has:
blocks.question_hi: n घात के एक बहुपद में होते हैं:
blocks.explanation: A polynomial of degree n can have at most n real zeroes.
blocks.explanation_hi: n घात वाले एक बहुपद के अधिकतम n वास्तविक शून्यक हो सकते हैं।

blocks.question: If α and β are zeroes of x² - 4x + 1, then the value of 1/α + 1/β is:
blocks.question_hi: यदि α और β, x² - 4x + 1 के शून्यक हैं, तो 1/α + 1/β का मान है:
blocks.explanation: α + β = 4 and αβ = 1. Therefore, 1/α + 1/β = (α + β) / (αβ) = 4 / 1 = 4.

blocks.question: What is the geometrical meaning of the zeroes of a polynomial p(x)?
blocks.question_hi: बहुपद p(x) के शून्यकों का ज्यामितीय अर्थ क्या है?
options: The points where graph intersects y-axis
The points where graph intersects x-axis
The highest point of the graph
The lowest point of the graph
options_hi: वे बिंदु जहाँ ग्राफ y-अक्ष को प्रतिच्छेद करता है
वे बिंदु जहाँ ग्राफ x-अक्ष को प्रतिच्छेद करता है
blocks.explanation: The zeroes of a polynomial p(x) are the x-coordinates of the points where the graph of y = p(x) intersects the x-axis.
blocks.explanation_hi: बहुपद p(x) के शून्यक उन बिंदुओं के x-निर्देशांक होते हैं जहाँ y = p(x) का ग्राफ x-अक्ष को प्रतिच्छेद करता है।

blocks.question: If the sum of the zeroes of the quadratic polynomial kx² + 2x + 3k is equal to their product, then k equals:
blocks.question_hi: यदि द्विघात बहुपद kx² + 2x + 3k के शून्यकों का योग उनके गुणनफल के बराबर है, तो k बराबर है:
blocks.explanation: Sum of zeroes = -2/k. Product of zeroes = 3k/k = 3. Given -2/k = 3, so k = -2/3.
blocks.explanation_hi: शून्यकों का योग = -2/k। शून्यकों का गुणनफल = 3k/k = 3। दिया गया है -2/k = 3, इसलिए k = -2/3।

blocks.question: If one zero of the polynomial 3x² + 8x + k is the reciprocal of the other, then value of k is:
blocks.question_hi: यदि बहुपद 3x² + 8x + k का एक शून्यक दूसरे का व्युत्क्रम है, तो k का मान है:
blocks.explanation: Let zeroes be α and 1/α. Their product = α × (1/α) = 1. Also product of zeroes = k/3. Therefore, k/3 = 1 => k = 3.
blocks.explanation_hi: माना शून्यक α और 1/α हैं। उनका गुणनफल = α × (1/α) = 1। शून्यकों का गुणनफल = k/3 भी है। इसलिए, k/3 = 1 => k = 3।

blocks.question: The graph of a polynomial p(x) intersects the x-axis at exactly 3 distinct points. What can be the minimum degree of p(x)?
blocks.question_hi: एक बहुपद p(x) का ग्राफ x-अक्ष को ठीक 3 अलग-अलग बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेद करता है। p(x) की न्यूनतम घात क्या हो सकती है?
blocks.explanation: Since the graph intersects the x-axis at 3 distinct points, it has exactly 3 real zeroes. Therefore, the minimum degree of the polynomial is 3 (a cubic polynomial).
blocks.explanation_hi: चूँकि ग्राफ x-अक्ष को 3 अलग-अलग बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेद करता है, इसके ठीक 3 वास्तविक शून्यक हैं। इसलिए, बहुपद की न्यूनतम घात 3 (एक त्रिघात बहुपद) है।
